title: Knockout Roasted Syrian Chorizo Pilaf
description: A flavorful and spicy roasted Syrian dish featuring chorizo and pilaf, perfect for a weeknight dinner, with a vegetarian-friendly option by substituting chorizo with roasted vegetables

ingredients.name: Syrian chorizo
ingredients.notes: or substitute with 1 cup roasted vegetables

instructions: In a large bowl, combine rice, water, salt, black pepper, paprika, and cumin, and soak for 30 minutes.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the Syrian chorizo to the skillet and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
In a large roasting pan, combine the cooked rice mixture, chorizo mixture, and 1 cup of water, and stir to combine.
Cover the roasting pan with aluminum foil and roast in the preheated oven for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
